message:
You know, there’s something oddly satisfying about finally being the prepared one in a family of ‘wing-it’ folks. With storm season upon us, I took a moment to dive into some solid resources about flooding. The National Weather Service has some great tips on what to do before, during, and after a storm. I’ve even started making a little checklist for our emergency kit—because who doesn’t want to be the hero when the skies turn gray? 

What’s your go-to tip for staying calm and ready when the weather gets wild? 🌧️
